title: Agents
subtitle: Agents read the conversation and propose changes. They never make one.

roster.removeConfirm: Remove {name}? It leaves the roster and stops answering. Everything it proposed is kept, so approved changes stay attributable.

create.title: Add an agent
create.handleHint: What people type after the @. Lowercase, no spaces.
create.modelHint: Paste the model name exactly as it appears on openrouter.ai/models — for example anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5 or perplexity/sonar.
create.modelInvalid: That does not look like an OpenRouter model name. They are written vendor/model.
create.systemPromptHint: What this agent is for and how it should behave. The whole team can read this.
create.allowedHint: Checked in the database when someone approves, so an agent cannot be talked into anything outside this list.
create.handleLocked: The handle cannot change — messages already address this agent by it.
create.runtimeHint: Where this agent runs. Most agents should stay on the OpenRouter path — it answers in one call and costs a fraction of a harness run.
create.runtimeWarning: Harness agents run in an isolated container with a real workspace and structured file tools. They still cannot change anything directly: a run ends as a message and proposals that someone has to approve. Only promote an agent to the harness once the runner is healthy, and start with a low budget.
create.toolProfileHint: Operator is the only profile with a workspace. The other two read the platform and nothing else.
create.maxToolStepsHint: How many times the model may call a tool in one run. Stops a loop from becoming a bill.
create.maxRunSecondsHint: How long one run may take before it is abandoned. Separate from the step limit: a run can stall without spending anything.

proposal.heading: {agent} proposes
proposal.adminOnly: Only an admin can approve this.
proposal.waiverHint: Required when a gate is missing evidence. Write it in your own words — this goes into the waiver register under your name.

openrouter.title: OpenRouter
openrouter.subtitle: Every agent calls OpenRouter with this key. Each agent picks its own model.
openrouter.notConfigured: No key saved. Agents cannot answer until one is.
openrouter.label: Key name
openrouter.uncappedWarning: This key has no spend limit. Use a test key with a limit set on it — an unattended schedule holding an uncapped key is exactly the risk this guards against.
openrouter.apiKeyHint: Create a limited test key at openrouter.ai/settings/keys and set a monthly spend limit on it. The key is encrypted before it is stored and is never readable from the browser.

schedules.title: Scheduled runs
schedules.subtitle: Admins only. A scheduled agent still proposes — it cannot change anything on its own.
schedules.name: Name
schedules.cronHint: Five-field cron, in UTC. For example 0 9 * * 1 is every Monday at 09:00.

runs.title: Agent activity
runs.subtitle: The last runs, newest first. Harness runs take minutes and report the phase they are in.

errors.generic: That did not work. Try again.
errors.invalid: Check the fields and try again.
errors.unreachable: The agent service is not reachable. It may not be deployed yet.
errors.notPermitted: That agent is not allowed to propose this action.
errors.waiverRequired: Give a waiver reason before approving this.
errors.notFound: That is no longer there. Refresh and try again.
errors.commitFailed: The patch was approved but could not be committed. The card shows why.
errors.commitUnrecorded: The patch was committed, but the platform could not record it. Do not approve it again — check the repository first.
